title: I don't hold grudges. I file them.
caption:
Scorpio doesn't hold grudges. Scorpio laminates them and files them in a vault.
Holding on doesn't punish them, it just keeps you up. You don't have to forgive it all today, just open the door.
Send this to the friend with a grudge vault.
